description: Reusable PACK/SOURCE catalog for Resonance. Durable research record so future builders never re-research the same libraries. Machine-readable twin of the generated assets/generated/CATALOG.md. Individual assets in REGISTRY.json reference these via sourcePackId. Governing policy: docs/16_Audio_Source_License_Bible.md (protected). Statuses: approved | approved-per-file | reference-only | needs-license-check.

sources.creator: SONNISS (multi-vendor bundles)
sources.license: SONNISS Royalty-Free (GameAudioGDC terms)
sources.modificationRedistribution: Modification allowed; NEVER redistribute raw files as a standalone library; no AI/ML training use.
sources.purchase: Free bundles; purchased SONNISS libraries also acceptable when a specific library is worth buying (flag before purchase).

sources.attribution: Credit Miriani-Next v4.2.15 and its nine credited sources — full text in assets/REGISTRY.json (attributionText on SRC-AUD-015 entries), generated into game credits.

sources.preferredUse: Blind-first sound-information architecture REFERENCE (variants, informative audio).
sources.notes: Oct 17, 2026: status moved from reference-only to needs-license-check to permit registered imports under recorded conditions — this is NOT approved-per-file: no verified per-file licences exist. Conditions: (1) Kit's revised ruling — no blanket quarantine over the pack's Star Wars ULTIMATE SFX COLLECTION credit; only positively identified franchise-derived sounds are flagged individually, and a full filename scan found none in the Gate One selection; (2) licence research (Oct 17, 2026) found no documented per-file licence for any of the 70 unique Gate One sources — a permission-contact list for identifiable holders is held with the sound library research, and replacement sourcing (licensed libraries) remains available; (3) Nexus directions — environments wiring proceeds now; the credit chain is preserved exactly as the pack gives it and tops out at the pack's own credited names, with the standing note that Star Wars audio/IP belongs to its rights holders and the game is unaffiliated; commercial distribution licences are intended for all shipped sounds by publication. A public repository does not relicense bundled third-party recordings.

sources.name: YouTube Audio Library / Creator Music
sources.creator: various
sources.license: per track for YouTube use; off-platform game embedding requires the underlying license to independently permit it
sources.modificationRedistribution: Creator Music licenses are tied to particular YouTube long-form videos — NEVER game-asset licenses.
sources.preferredUse: The project's OWN YouTube videos, trailers, devlogs, promotion. Discovery pool only for in-game use.
sources.notes: Never rip from standard-license videos; 'no copyright' titles mean nothing; a normal video is a source only with owner-granted clear license + saved evidence. Flips to approved-per-file only when a track's underlying license verifiably grants off-platform game rights.
